title: Choose the word that can bear honor
summary: This meets a mouth ready to wound, posture, or bargain. The line asks for words that can survive truth.
takeaway: Speak only what can bear honor.
lifeApplication: Before the sharp reply leaves, rest the tongue against the teeth for one breath. Speak only what you would be willing to hear repeated in the Guru's presence.

source.shortMeaning: Speech carries your honor long before reputation does.
source.lifeApplication: Before replying sharply, speak only what you could repeat before the Guru.

evidence.coreClaim: Speech carries your honor long before reputation does.
evidence.turn: Keep only the speech that can stand at God's Door.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before the sharp reply leaves, rest the tongue against the teeth for one breath. Speak only what you would be willing to hear repeated in the Guru's presence.
